name: sheet
description: A slide-in panel from the viewport edge for secondary tasks — filters, navigation, detail panels, settings. Built on Radix UI Dialog with a side prop. Shares the same primitive as Dialog but is positional rather than centered.

intent.Horizontal: 380px wide, full viewport height. Maps to side='right' (default) or side='left'. Use for side panels: filters, detail views, navigation drawers, settings.
intent.Vertical: Full viewport width, 423px tall. Maps to side='bottom' or side='top'. Use for bottom sheets on mobile-first layouts, command palettes, full-width menus.

intent.380px: Default side panel (Side=Horizontal). Filters, quick edits, settings.
intent.560px: Wide side panel (Side=Horizontal only). Record detail/edit forms with two columns. Fill color/surface/default, title 14 Medium, 24px close button, horizontal footer with two equal buttons.

Size.note: Not every Side x Size combination exists in Figma: Horizontal = 380px | 560px, Vertical = 1200px.

sheetBody.type: SLOT — replace with any content appropriate to the sheet's purpose

composition.structure: V AUTO-LAYOUT (no root padding, no gap): sheet-header → sheet-body (SLOT) → sheet-footer
composition.bodySlot: sheet-body is a SLOT — replace with any content: form fields, data, nav links, settings rows, command input + results.
composition.footerButtons: Both footer buttons are full-width (fill container) — stacked vertically. Do not place them in a horizontal row.

openClose.open: Via SheetTrigger, or controlled with open + onOpenChange.

behavior.focusTrap: Focus trapped inside SheetContent while open. Tab cycles through focusable elements. Returns to trigger on close.
behavior.animation: Radix uses data-state='open'/'closed'. Shadcn applies CSS translate animations matched to the side direction.
behavior.scrollBehavior: sheet-body does not scroll by default in code — add overflow-y:auto when content may exceed available height. Header and footer remain fixed.

sheetVsDialog.Sheet: Edge of viewport, slides in — secondary tasks, filters, nav, detail panels.
sheetVsDialog.Dialog: Centered, fades in — focused interruptions, confirmations, short forms.

accessibility.role: role='dialog' with aria-modal='true' (Radix UI Dialog default)
accessibility.sheetTitleRequired: Always include <SheetTitle> — use <VisuallyHidden> if not visually shown.
keyboard: Tab / Shift+Tab to move focus within sheet
Enter / Space to activate focused button

constraints: Use Sheet for secondary tasks that don't require the user to lose page context — filters, quick edits, detail previews, navigation.
Use Dialog for focused interruptions requiring full attention — confirmations, destructive actions, multi-step flows.
Do not use Sheet for destructive confirmations — use Alert Dialog.
Footer buttons are full-width by design — do not place them in a horizontal row inside Side=Horizontal.
Add overflow-y:auto to sheet-body in code when content may be taller than the panel.
Side=Vertical is wide and short — not suited for tall forms; use Side=Horizontal instead.

useCases: User clicks 'Filters' in a data table and a right panel slides in with filter controls, keeping the table visible behind it
Selecting a row in a list opens a detail panel on the right showing the record's full information without navigating away
A settings sidebar slides in from the right when the user clicks the gear icon in the top nav
A mobile-style page uses a bottom sheet (Side=Vertical) as a global command palette that spans the full width
An 'Edit contact' action opens a side panel so the user can see the contact record while editing it
A left-side navigation drawer slides in on a responsive layout when the hamburger menu is tapped

Horizontal.whenToUse: Panels that are spatially related to left/right content — 380px wide, full height

Vertical.whenToUse: Panels that span the full viewport width — bottom or top edge, typically mobile-first

comparedTo.situation: Secondary contextual task without losing page context
Blocking decision required before the user can proceed
Bottom-anchored panel on mobile with swipe-to-dismiss gesture
Persistent vertical nav along the left edge

notes: Sheet and Dialog share the same Radix UI Dialog primitive — the distinction is purely positional.
Footer button fills are intentional — the parent sets the root fill on each button instance (primary/outline). These fills are required and should not be cleared.

Story Wide560.

Figma renamed the 560px variant property: `Direction=560px` -> `Size=560px` (Size options 380px | 560px | 1200px, next to Side). No visual change. Code prop `size` default|wide unchanged; mapping documented in variants.Size.
